function.description: Read CTRL (Control) of the example three-phase PWM driver.
function.name: pwm1_read_ctrl

function.description: Write CTRL (Control) of the example three-phase PWM driver. Name only the fields to change; the others keep their value. A value outside a field's limits is refused with the reason, not adjusted.
function.name: pwm1_set_ctrl

en.description: Enable. Off holds every gate low.

fault_clr.description: Clear the fault latch. Write true to trigger; it reads back false.

mode.description: Commutation mode. six_step: Six-step from the sector. sinusoidal: Sinusoidal from the position; needs PERIOD between 20 and 200 us. foc: Field-oriented control. Limit: sinusoidal commutation needs a PWM period of at least 20 us. Limit: sinusoidal commutation needs a PWM period of at most 200 us.

src.description: Position source. hall: Hall switches (reset). encoder: Quadrature encoder.

function.description: Read STATUS (Status) of the example three-phase PWM driver.
function.name: pwm1_read_status

function.description: Read PERIOD (PWM period) of the example three-phase PWM driver.
function.name: pwm1_read_period

function.description: Write PERIOD (PWM period) of the example three-phase PWM driver. Name only the fields to change; the others keep their value. A value outside a field's limits is refused with the reason, not adjusted.
function.name: pwm1_set_period

period.description: PWM period. 50 us is 20 kHz. In us, resolution 0.1. Limit: sinusoidal commutation needs a PWM period of at least 20 us. Limit: sinusoidal commutation needs a PWM period of at most 200 us. Limit: the on-time must not exceed the PWM period.

function.description: Read DUTY (PWM on-time) of the example three-phase PWM driver.
function.name: pwm1_read_duty

function.description: Write DUTY (PWM on-time) of the example three-phase PWM driver. Name only the fields to change; the others keep their value. A value outside a field's limits is refused with the reason, not adjusted.
function.name: pwm1_set_duty

duty.description: On-time per period. In us, resolution 0.1. Limit: the on-time must not exceed the PWM period.

function.description: Read DEADTIME (Dead time between a leg's high and low gates) of the example three-phase PWM driver.
function.name: pwm1_read_deadtime

function.description: Write DEADTIME (Dead time between a leg's high and low gates) of the example three-phase PWM driver. Name only the fields to change; the others keep their value. A value outside a field's limits is refused with the reason, not adjusted.
function.name: pwm1_set_deadtime

function.description: Read ANGLE (Rotor angle and magnitude. Reading clears STATUS.READY) of the example three-phase PWM driver. Reading it changes the device's state (see the description), so read it only when that is intended.

function.description: Read SENSE (Current sense trims and trip level) of the example three-phase PWM driver.

trip.description: Over-current trip reference. In mV, resolution 2.5. Needs a person's confirmation; ask before calling.
